title: Nope
tagline: Don't look up. Look at the snacks.
about: Two siblings on a horse ranch try to film the thing hiding in the clouds above their valley.
cue: Serve the snacks when the crowd sits down at the western theme park show.

    StartersStar Lasso Experience popcornPopcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked paprika and chipotleHow to make it120g popcorn kernels60g butter1 tsp smoked paprika1 pinch chipotle powder1 tsp fine salt2 tbsp oil, for poppingPop the kernels in the oil in a covered pot.Cook the butter until golden and nutty, then stir in the paprika, chipotle and salt.Toss through the popcorn and fill striped paper bags.Chuckwagon beansPinto beans with bacon, chipotle, molasses and tomato paste, cooked in cast ironHow to make it150g bacon, diced1 onion, diced2 tins of pinto beans, drained1 chipotle in adobo, chopped2 tbsp molasses2 tbsp tomato paste250ml waterFry the bacon and onion in a cast-iron pot until golden.Add the beans, chipotle, molasses, tomato paste and water.Simmer for 30 minutes until thick and smoky.Serve in tin cups.Haywood ranch smoky beef jerkyThe Haywood horse ranch in the valleyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin strips of topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, black pepper and smoked paprika, dried low in the oven until chewy and smoky.Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice across the grain into 4mm strips.Mix 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder.Toss the beef through and marinate overnight.Pat dry and lay on racks over trays.Dry at 75°C with the oven door propped open a crack for 3 to 4 hours until leathery but still bendy.Grilled street corn with cotija and chilliKeep your eyes down. Mix the tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime for salsa.Slice the meat and serve.Angel's night shift chicken tinga burritosAngel from Fry's brings dinner for the long watch on the cloudsHow to make it700g chicken thigh fillets1 onion, sliced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, chopped400g tinned chopped tomatoes200g long grain rice400g tin black beans, drained8 large flour tortillas150g cheddar, grated1/4 iceberg lettuce, shredded1 tbsp olive oilSoften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the chipotle, tomatoes and chicken and simmer until tender. Meanwhile cook the rice.Shred the chicken into the sauce and cook until thick.Warm the beans and tortillas.Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, chicken, cheese and lettuce and roll up tight.SweetsJean Jacket flying saucer cookiesChocolate cookies sandwiched with marshmallowHow to make it100g dark chocolate100g butter150g brown sugar1 egg180g plain flour8 marshmallows1 tbsp silver sprinklesMelt the chocolate with the butter, beat in the sugar and egg, then the flour.Shape small rounds and bake at 175°C for 9 minutes.
